scripts.build: node scripts/check-tools.mjs && forge build --root contracts && node scripts/export-environment-artifact.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && pnpm --filter @confidential-utxo/crypto build
scripts.test: node scripts/check-tools.mjs && forge build --root contracts && node --test tests/environment/check-tools.test.mjs tests/environment/entrypoints.test.mjs tests/environment/verifier-artifact-guard.test.mjs tests/environment/pool-artifact-guard.test.mjs tests/environment/pool-deployment.test.mjs && forge test --root contracts && vitest run tests/environment/artifact-guard.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @confidential-utxo/crypto test
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json && forge fmt --check --root contracts && pnpm --filter @confidential-utxo/crypto check
scripts.check:uniswap: node scripts/uniswap-source.mjs verify && node scripts/uniswap-artifact.mjs verify
